message.content:
An editorial illustration features a large, dark green luxury van being carried on poles by a crowd of people. A man in a dark suit and red tie stands emerging from the top of the van with his arms raised towards a cloudy, orange-tinted sky. The van has a stylized gold and green logo that reads "ACT" on its windshield.

Below, multiple people, some wearing white head coverings or black vests with the "ACT" logo, use long poles to lift the vehicle. Their faces are rendered in a simplified, warm-toned style. They are positioned in the lower half of the frame, supporting the weight of the van from beneath.

The word "TEMPO" is printed in large red letters across the top. To the left, large black text reads "KANTONG BOCOR DANA UMAT". Below this, smaller text describes a philanthropy organization. Other text includes "Kaki Buntung Satgas PMK H.86" and "Di Balik Suap Izin Tambang Tanah Bumbu H.74". A barcode and "4-10 JULI 2022" are visible at the bottom left.
